_comment: Bullet-proof prompts + per-category flags for Galactic Horizon. alpha=true -> background removed (transparent PNG) via a cutout node; tileable=true -> seamless circular tiling. Names/folders per docs/design/ASSET_PIPELINE.md, no proprietary names.
negative_common: text, words, letters, caption, watermark, signature, logo, blurry, out of focus, low quality, jpeg artifacts, deformed, duplicate, extra objects, frame, border

nebula.template: Seamless tileable deep-space nebula texture, abstract diffuse glowing gas clouds filling the entire frame edge to edge, evenly distributed with no central object and no focal point, scattered ember cores, fine star dust, {palette} palette, {layer}, dark near-black space, flat even lighting, digital matte painting texture
nebula.negative: black hole, accretion disk, central object, focal point, vortex, swirl center, symmetrical composition, planet, sun, star with rays, spaceship, character, vignette, horizon, ground

layer.far: very faint subtle low-contrast haze, mostly empty dark space

planets.template: A single complete planet rendered as a perfect circle, the entire globe centered and fully surrounded by empty space with nothing around it and nothing below it, {type}, soft directional sunlight from one side, plain flat uniform neutral grey background, studio product shot of a planet globe, sharp focus, highly detailed
planets.negative: clouds outside the planet, mist, fog, haze, waves, ocean below, platform, pedestal, base, stand, ground, surface below the planet, foreground, two planets, multiple planets, second planet, moon, spaceship, partial planet, cropped sphere, bottom cut off

type.terrestrial: blue oceans, white swirling clouds, green and brown continents
type.gas: banded gas giant with a great swirling storm spot, orange and cream bands
type.ice: white and pale-cyan frozen world with cracked ice and frost
type.volcanic: black basalt surface with glowing orange lava rivers and fissures
type.industrial: grey metallic surface, sprawling city lights glowing on the night side
type.habitat: ringed orbital habitat megastructure, metallic, lit windows

planet_maps.template: Seamless full-frame flat texture, a wide 2:1 rectangular surface swatch that completely fills the frame edge to edge with NO central object and no border, {type}, evenly and uniformly lit, flat lighting, no shadows, no curvature, ultra-detailed surface material, sharp focus
planet_maps.negative: globe, sphere, orb, ball, circle, round, disc, ring, concentric circles, eye, iris, planet object, planet in space, vignette, dark corners, radial, road map, street map, atlas, compass, charts, text, labels, grid, frame, border, margins, letterbox, black background, stars, outer space, horizon, 3d render of a sphere

type.terrestrial: blue ocean water with green and brown landmasses and scattered thin white clouds, seen from directly overhead, satellite imagery of terrain
type.gas: swirling horizontal cloud bands in orange, cream and amber with turbulent storm eddies, gas-giant atmosphere seen from directly overhead
type.ice: cracked white and pale-cyan ice sheets with frost, fractures and ridges, frozen polar terrain seen from directly overhead
type.volcanic: black basalt rock veined with glowing orange and yellow lava rivers and cracks, volcanic terrain seen from directly overhead

type.neutron: tiny intensely bright white neutron star with sharp polar beams

ships.template: A sci-fi starship spacecraft seen from directly above, orthographic top-down view, flat, the ship pointing straight up with its nose/bow at the top edge of the image and its engine thrusters at the bottom, vertical symmetry, {role}, glowing engine thrusters at the rear (bottom), clean readable silhouette, centered, full ship visible, plain flat neutral grey background, concept art, sharp focus
ships.negative: legs, animal, creature, robot dog, mecha, walker, person, side view, perspective view, nose pointing sideways, nose pointing down, horizontal ship, tilted, diagonal, ground, sky, planet, scenery, cropped, multiple ships

role.trader: bulky merchant freighter with cargo pods, worn metal
